name: gamesom
description: Your game library's sommelier: mood- and context-fit picks from the games you already own. Ask Claude: "what should I play tonight?"
long_description:
gamesom imports your library from Steam, GOG, Epic, and itch.io, keeps track of what's actually installed, and briefs Claude as your personal game sommelier — helping you choose from your real backlog based on tonight's energy, mood, and time, instead of recommending universally 'good' games you'll never start.

After installing, just ask Claude: "what should I play tonight?" The sommelier will offer to import your library on first run.

Troubleshooting: if tool calls stop responding, toggle the extension off and on in Settings → Extensions.

tools.name: list_games
tools.description: List games from the library with optional filters (installed-only, source, profile presence).

tools.name: get_game
tools.description: Get a game with all library entries and its sommelier profile.

tools.name: upsert_profile
tools.description: Persist sommelier judgments (energy, friction, session fit) for a game.

tools.name: mark_completed
tools.description: Mark a game completed or clear its completion timestamp.

tools.name: refresh_library
tools.description: Re-import the library from detected (or specified) launchers.

prompts.name: sommelier
prompts.description: Brief Claude as your Computer Game Sommelier for this session.

steam_api_key.title: Steam Web API Key (optional)
steam_api_key.description: Adds your full Steam ownership, not just installed games. Get one at https://steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey — or leave empty to import installed Steam games only.

steam_id.title: SteamID64 (optional)
steam_id.description: Your 64-bit Steam ID, needed only together with the API key.
